purpose: Tool contracts, runtime behavior, verification boundaries, bounded repository capabilities, and mobile-safe execution.

entries.name: read_file
entries.output: plain numbered text plus structured range/cache/tool-output retrieval metadata
entries.permission: PermissionGate via risk=read; project/scope path containment in tool
entries.cancellation: AbortSignal threaded through filesystem and tool-output retrieval paths
entries.persistence: tool result persisted as a normal tool message; read-state cache retained separately; oversized tool output stored by ToolOutputStore
entries.contextCost: requested range is bounded by read limits; oversized tool-result references are paginated deliberately
entries.gap: Directory/search/read parity is implemented; provider-turn lifecycle and richer cross-tool retrieval semantics are now handled by the durable agent/provider lifecycle layer.
entries.designNotes: FileReadTool + FileStateCache; read + read-filesystem

entries.name: write_file
entries.output: wrote byte count + diff metadata
entries.permission: PermissionGate via risk=write; project/scope path containment
entries.cancellation: not explicitly cancellable during filesystem mutation
entries.persistence: tool message persisted; filesystem snapshots handled separately by session store
entries.contextCost: diff metadata plus short status text
entries.gap: Existing files can be overwritten without a prior full-read freshness guard or atomic write-if-unchanged check.
entries.designNotes: FileWriteTool with read-state and mtime guard; write

entries.name: edit_file
entries.output: replacement count + diff metadata
entries.permission: PermissionGate via risk=write; project/scope path containment
entries.cancellation: not explicitly cancellable during read-modify-write
entries.concurrency: not parallelSafe; no stale-read atomic guard
entries.persistence: tool message persisted; snapshots handled separately
entries.contextCost: diff metadata plus short status text
entries.gap: No fresh-read/mtime guard, atomic mutation window, BOM/line-ending fidelity contract, or structured stale-edit error state.
entries.designNotes: FileEditTool; edit

entries.name: grep
entries.output: ripgrep text output or fallback text lines
entries.cancellation: ripgrep path receives abort signal; fallback fs traversal does not
entries.persistence: normal tool message
entries.contextCost: bounded by maxResults/maxOutput characters
entries.gap: Fallback is substring matching rather than regex and output lacks structured match/truncation metadata.
entries.designNotes: GrepTool; grep

entries.name: glob
entries.output: newline-separated relative paths
entries.permission: PermissionGate via risk=read; traversal rooted at cwd
entries.cancellation: not explicitly cancellable
entries.persistence: normal tool message
entries.contextCost: bounded by maxResults but no count/truncation structure
entries.gap: Hand-written walker lacks shared search service, explicit root, deterministic structured pagination/count metadata, and centralized traversal policy.
entries.designNotes: GlobTool; glob

entries.name: bash
entries.output: durable task identity + bounded stdout/stderr combined output preview + output file reference + exit/termination metadata
entries.permission: PermissionGate via risk=shell; command execution is durable; Git has separate argument-aware classifier
entries.cancellation: AbortSignal + process-group termination with SIGTERM/SIGKILL grace
entries.persistence: TaskManager JSON record + task event log + durable output file
entries.contextCost: bounded preview bytes with head/tail retention; long-running work leaves provider turn via background promotion
entries.gap: Separate stdout/stderr channel files and richer resource-level shell permission approval remain future work; ordinary oversized result retention is now provided by ToolOutputStore.
entries.designNotes: BashTool + TaskOutputTool; shell + background job/task infrastructure

entries.name: git
entries.output: argument classification + durable task identity + bounded command output + termination metadata
entries.permission: PermissionGate via risk=shell plus argument-aware destructive classifier; destructive commands explicitly blocked
entries.cancellation: Same durable shell runner as bash with process-group cancellation
entries.persistence: TaskManager JSON record + task event log + durable output file
entries.contextCost: bounded tool-output projection with durable full output reference; background promotion keeps long work out of the blocking provider turn
entries.gap: Destructive operations currently fail closed rather than entering a richer argument-specific approval workflow; richer approval belongs to 13K.
entries.designNotes: BashTool + filesystem permissions; shell + resource-aware permission boundary

entries.name: apply_patch
entries.output: sequential add/update/delete summary + bounded per-file diffs and structured patch metadata
entries.permission: one edit PermissionGate request containing all target resources; project/scope containment prevents external targets
entries.cancellation: Abort-aware through registry/tool context; filesystem mutation is serialized per target and conditional for update/delete
entries.concurrency: unsafe; batch owns multiple filesystem mutations and is not advertised as parallel-safe
entries.persistence: normal tool result; mutation is reflected in existing file/read state and session lifecycle
entries.contextCost: patch input and rendered diffs are bounded; patch text capped at 200000 bytes and each diff at 24000 bytes
entries.gap: Move hunks are intentionally unsupported because the V2 implementation currently rejects apply_patch moves; operations remain sequential rather than atomic, with explicit partial-application failure reporting.
entries.designNotes: FileEdit/FileWrite mutation and preflight concepts where applicable; runtime component/patch.ts + runtime component/tool/apply-patch.ts

entries.name: repo_map
entries.output: token-bounded structural repository map
entries.cancellation: not explicitly cancellable
entries.persistence: normal tool message
entries.contextCost: explicit token bound
entries.gap: Keep only while complementary and bounded; avoid duplicating filesystem discovery semantics.
entries.designNotes: no direct equivalent; no direct single-tool equivalent; overlaps with glob/grep/codesearch/context

entries.name: question

schema.question: string|required per item
schema.id: stable que_* request id derived from session/tool call/question shape

entries.output: structured {status,answers,requestId} + compact formatted text
entries.cancellation: explicit cancelled state or AbortSignal cancellation
entries.concurrency: not designed for concurrent question surfaces
entries.persistence: question.asked/replied/rejected/cancelled durable events; replay prevents re-asking the same persisted request
entries.contextCost: compact formatted answer text; structured answer state remains machine-owned
entries.gap: Native V2 question HTTP/API parity is still represented through existing TermAgent UI/server callbacks rather than a dedicated question service endpoint.
entries.designNotes: AskUserQuestionTool; question

entries.name: background
entries.output: durable task id + worker pid; output remains in managed task storage
entries.cancellation: task_cancel can signal process group when process identity matches
entries.concurrency: durable task lock; many tasks may exist
entries.persistence: JSON TaskRecord + task event log + managed output file
entries.contextCost: short launch acknowledgement; completion arrives as compact notification
entries.gap: Shell background execution is durable and cancellable; foreground-to-background promotion remains a separate shell-runtime concern.
entries.designNotes: BashTool background execution + TaskOutputTool; shell background jobs / BackgroundJob infrastructure

entries.name: task_status
entries.output: curated durable task state with lifecycle/termination metadata, parent/child linkage, result/error, and output reference
entries.cancellation: n/a
entries.persistence: reads durable TaskManager state without loading raw output
entries.contextCost: bounded task status plus deliberate output retrieval rather than full durable output injection
entries.gap: No raw output is returned unless task_output is explicitly requested.
entries.designNotes: TaskOutputTool; task_status/process-query mechanisms

entries.name: task_cancel
entries.output: short status text
entries.cancellation: this is the cancellation operation
entries.persistence: task record + event log
entries.contextCost: minimal
entries.gap: Cancellation is durable for task state and worker cleanup; provider-turn tool interruption is tracked separately by 13G lifecycle events.
entries.designNotes: TaskOutputTool control paths; BackgroundJob interruption/task control

entries.name: background_agent
entries.output: durable task id + worker pid; compact completion notification to parent
entries.permission: child policy derived from parent gate; recursive task/meta tools narrowed by default
entries.cancellation: TaskManager cancel
entries.persistence: TaskRecord + child SessionStore session + task event log + output file
entries.contextCost: launch acknowledgement plus compact completion notification; child transcript remains outside parent context
entries.gap: Detailed child transcript is available only through explicit child-session/task-output retrieval.
entries.designNotes: AgentTool/forked agent + task output; task + background job

entries.name: parallel_agents
entries.output: list of durable task ids with explicit non-overlapping scopes
entries.cancellation: per-task task_cancel
entries.concurrency: explicit 2-4 cap + non-overlap path checks + session lock
entries.persistence: TaskManager records + worker output
entries.contextCost: small launch result
entries.gap: Parallel wrapper remains a TermAgent-specific bounded launcher; result retrieval converges on task_status/task_output.
entries.designNotes: parallel agent/fork support; multiple task tool calls + background jobs

entries.name: task
entries.output: compact task result with durable task/child-session metadata; background returns immediately
entries.permission: child policy derived from parent gate and persisted into the child task
entries.cancellation: foreground wait propagates parent abort to the child task; detached background work remains independently cancellable through task_cancel
entries.concurrency: worker-owned child session; background tasks may run concurrently subject to scope conflict rules
entries.persistence: durable TaskRecord + child SessionStore + task event log + output file
entries.contextCost: foreground returns bounded child result; background returns launch acknowledgement and later compact parent notification
entries.gap: Task/session execution is now unified around durable task records; distributed multi-process ownership remains outside this phase.
entries.designNotes: AgentTool / forked agent; task

entries.name: todo
entries.output: structured metadata {old,new,active,completed,collapsed,verificationNudge} + JSON list
entries.cancellation: normal tool-call cancellation
entries.concurrency: session mutations are serialized in server/session variant
entries.persistence: durable todo events store current items plus previous snapshot; live UI exposes active items only
entries.contextCost: machine-owned active/completed state; completed-only UI projection collapses
entries.gap: Todo persistence is session-event based rather than a dedicated SQL table like current the V2 implementation; behavior is otherwise aligned for the native TermAgent path.
entries.designNotes: TodoWriteTool; todo

entries.name: verify_project
entries.output: exit/signal + bounded output + durable task identifier and managed-output metadata
entries.permission: PermissionGate via risk=shell; scoped workers forbid arbitrary command
entries.cancellation: AbortSignal passed to child; timeout distinct only in metadata/output path
entries.persistence: TaskManager shell task record, task event log, managed output file, plus normal tool result
entries.contextCost: bounded output in model context
entries.gap: Verification now settles on the same durable task/output lifecycle as shell execution; full provider-specific verification UX remains future refinement.
entries.designNotes: Bash verification patterns + task/output lifecycle; shell/task lifecycle + session verification workflow

entries.name: agent_mode
entries.output: short state text
entries.cancellation: n/a
entries.persistence: not explicitly persisted as a state event by the tool
entries.contextCost: minimal
entries.gap: TermAgent-specific UX/runtime mode switch; persistence is weaker than other session-owned state.
entries.designNotes: agent mode/profile configuration; agent/profile configuration

entries.name: search_skills
entries.output: JSON descriptor list + relevance
entries.cancellation: not explicitly cancellable
entries.concurrency: read-only; discovery keys dedupe within agent run
entries.persistence: skill.search/skill.skip events
entries.contextCost: descriptor-only by design, bounded to 12 results
entries.gap: Automatic discovery and explicit search coexist; discovery state is mostly represented as events rather than a durable machine context object.
entries.designNotes: skill discovery/loading subsystem; skill tool/catalog

entries.name: skill
entries.output: bounded SKILL.md body + base directory + sampled resource references + digest metadata
entries.cancellation: not explicitly cancellable
entries.persistence: skill.load event plus machine-state loadedSkills identity/digest
entries.contextCost: descriptor-only until explicit load; loaded body bounded by configured token cap
entries.gap: Native skill loading now matches the bounded explicit-load contract; loaded-skill identity is persisted into machine context and replay state.
entries.designNotes: skill loading / explicit invocation; skill (native on-demand loader)

entries.name: use_skill
entries.output: bounded SKILL.md body + base directory + sampled resource references + digest metadata
entries.cancellation: not explicitly cancellable
entries.persistence: skill.load event plus machine-state loadedSkills identity/digest
entries.contextCost: bounded body tokens; preserveOutput=true
entries.gap: Compatibility alias retained for existing TermAgent callers; native contract is now exposed as skill.
entries.designNotes: skill loading / explicit invocation; skill

entries.name: workflow_phase
entries.output: structured workflow state metadata + rendered JSON
entries.permission: handled directly by autonomous Agent; not actually executed through ToolRegistry
entries.cancellation: normal turn interruption
entries.persistence: workflow events plus machine-state workflow snapshot
entries.contextCost: small synthetic schema/result
entries.gap: TermAgent-specific workflow controller; verification state is persisted separately from ordinary tool text.
entries.designNotes: no exact analogue; plan/workflow/session state rather than one generic workflow tool

entries.name: plugin:*
entries.schema: ToolDefinition inputSchema (plugin-supplied JSON Schema)
entries.output: ToolDefinition result {output,title?,metadata?}
entries.permission: inherits canonical PermissionGate action/resource policy; plugin metadata defaults to task/read/write/shell action from tool contract
entries.cancellation: depends on plugin implementation; context includes AbortSignal
entries.persistence: tool.call lifecycle retains kind/provenance when invoked through Agent
entries.contextCost: stable schemas cached; dynamic selection bounded by active context budget
entries.gap: Plugin implementations may still define their own cancellation/resource semantics; registry enforces shared schema and permission boundaries.
entries.designNotes: plugin tools / hook system; custom plugin tools + registry

entries.name: mcp_<server>_<tool>
entries.schema: MCP tools/list inputSchema, retained as canonical inputSchema
entries.output: flattened text from MCP content blocks + metadata
entries.permission: canonical permission action/resource policy through shared registry gate
entries.cancellation: context AbortSignal reaches registry, while MCP JSON-RPC transport remains responsible for transport-level cancellation
entries.concurrency: normalized from read-only default; registry exposes concurrency metadata
entries.persistence: tool.call lifecycle retains kind= mcp and server provenance
entries.contextCost: stable definitions cached; selected MCP schemas are budget-bounded with other tools
entries.gap: MCP client transport remains intentionally lightweight and does not yet expose reference structured content blocks as a first-class result type.
entries.designNotes: MCP tool client/registry; MCP catalog + tool registry

entries.name: PermissionGate
entries.schema: tool + args + optional AbortSignal
entries.output: allow / deny / interactive requester choice
entries.permission: this is the permission decision point
entries.cancellation: fails closed before prompting when signal already aborted
entries.concurrency: approved decisions are shared by gate; prompt serialization delegated to UI
entries.persistence: rules from config; approvals live in memory
entries.contextCost: permission request is UI state, not ordinary model text
entries.gap: Authorization is primarily risk + serialized args-pattern matching, without resource extraction or typed permission requirements.
entries.designNotes: filesystem/permission matching and approval system; Permission service + resource-aware authorization

entries.name: ToolRegistry
entries.schema: ToolDefinition list
entries.output: OpenAI function schemas + tool result
entries.cancellation: passes ToolContext AbortSignal to tool
entries.persistence: no independent call-state persistence
entries.contextCost: schemas cached and then bounded by Agent
entries.gap: Registry is a thin map/executor; no typed input/output validation, registration identity, resource extraction, provider-hosted separation, or explicit settlement model.
entries.designNotes: Tool build/registry layer; Tool registry with definition identity and typed settlement

entries.name: Agent.run
entries.schema: provider turn with dynamically bounded tool schemas
entries.output: assistant text + provider-turn/task lifecycle events + persisted assistant/tool messages
entries.cancellation: single turn AbortController; tool execution receives signal
entries.concurrency: parallelSafe tool batches up to 4 concurrent calls with deterministic provider-order result emission
entries.persistence: provider.turn + tool.call lifecycle events + assistant/tool messages + compaction/workflow/todo events
entries.contextCost: shared estimator + ToolOutputStore bounded projections + explicit context accounting + compaction
entries.gap: Resource-level shell approval and richer child-task/session distributed ownership remain future phases; task/subagent/background execution now uses durable task records, child sessions, notifications, scope guards, and derived child permissions.
entries.designNotes: main agent loop + compaction orchestration; SessionProcessor + session runner/provider turn settlement

entries.name: ToolOutputStore
entries.schema: sessionId + toolCallId + textual result + optional metadata/attachments
entries.output: bounded provider-facing preview + stable virtual reference + persisted full result
entries.permission: virtual tool-output references resolve only within the managed store root
entries.cancellation: filesystem persistence follows the calling tool; cleanup is bounded and non-blocking
entries.concurrency: deterministic per-tool-call filenames allow concurrent independent binds
entries.persistence: managed .log payload + .json metadata sidecar with 7-day default retention
entries.contextCost: UTF-8 bytes + lines; preview sized against remaining provider request headroom
entries.gap: Separate stdout/stderr channels remain a shell-runtime refinement; lifecycle records and Phase 13H context checkpoints now retain output references outside prose context.
entries.designNotes: TaskOutput + toolResultStorage; ToolOutputStore + Truncate

entries.name: staged context compaction
entries.schema: messages + token budget + summary hints
entries.output: bounded tool projections, micro-pruned history, rolling summary, preserved recent complete units, machine-owned checkpoint
entries.cancellation: not independently cancellable
entries.concurrency: runs inline with current agent turn
entries.persistence: context.checkpoint + compaction events; full transcript remains durable; oversized tool payloads remain in ToolOutputStore
entries.contextCost: shared estimator; schemas, tool results, checkpoint notice, summary, recent turns, and read evidence all fit against one usable request budget
entries.gap: Automatic staged reduction and machine-owned checkpoints are implemented. Manual /compact remains an explicit full-compaction path by design; richer context resource replay remains future refinement.
entries.designNotes: compact.ts + sessionMemoryCompact.ts + file-state-aware compaction; SessionCompaction + ContextEpoch/session runner + projected history

entries.name: ToolCallLifecycle
entries.schema: sessionId + turnId + callId + raw/parsed arguments + provider metadata + lifecycle state/outcome
entries.output: durable pending/running/completed/error/interrupted provider-tool state
entries.permission: records outcomes after the existing PermissionGate decision; does not bypass authorization
entries.cancellation: AbortSignal maps interrupted tool calls to explicit interrupted terminal state
entries.concurrency: one lifecycle record per session/turn/call; parallel-safe tools settle concurrently while results emit deterministically
entries.persistence: tool.call event stream in SessionStore
entries.contextCost: execution truth is separate from rendered tool-result text and ToolOutputStore projection
entries.gap: Richer provider/runtime event replay and child-task integration remain future refinements.
entries.designNotes: StreamingToolExecutor + QueryLifecycleOperationTracker; Session runner + publish-llm-event tool state

entries.name: provider turn settlement
entries.schema: turnId + round + started/tool_settling/completed/error/interrupted + toolCallIds
entries.output: durable provider-turn boundary state
entries.cancellation: interrupted turn records distinct from provider/tool errors
entries.concurrency: tool calls may run concurrently; continuation waits for local settlement unless a tool itself returns background state
entries.persistence: provider.turn events + durable history reload
entries.contextCost: next provider request is rebuilt after reload from durable tool results
entries.gap: Durable multi-process session ownership and richer retry policy remain future work; provider turns now reload the active context checkpoint projection after local settlement.
entries.designNotes: query + StreamingToolExecutor; SessionPrompt/SessionRunner turn loop

entries.name: ContextMachineState
entries.schema: version + session/turn + epoch/checkpoint + projection hash + summary revision + read/tool/task/workflow/todo/mutation/continuation state
entries.output: bounded structured machine context for the provider plus durable state for reload
entries.cancellation: state is persisted atomically with the session checkpoint; tool cancellation is represented by ToolCallLifecycle
entries.persistence: context.checkpoint event; full transcript remains separate
entries.contextCost: renderMachineState() applies an explicit token budget; raw machine state is not required to fit in prose
entries.gap: Structured replay of additional provider-native resources remains future refinement.
entries.designNotes: compact.ts cache/file-state restoration and task/output state; Session runner context epoch/projection state

entries.name: context.checkpoint
entries.schema: sessionId + turnId + epoch + checkpointId + sourceEventCount + projectionHash + summaryRevision + stage + messages + machineState
entries.output: authoritative active provider projection after micro-prune or full compaction
entries.cancellation: failed checkpoint persistence is non-fatal to the current turn; stale checkpoints are ignored after undo/branch
entries.concurrency: SessionStore session lock serializes writes and deduplicates identical checkpoint state
entries.persistence: context.checkpoint JSONL event
entries.contextCost: checkpoint projection is measured with the same request estimator
entries.gap: Cross-process durable ownership of the active context writer remains future work.
entries.designNotes: compact boundary / preserved message segment metadata; ContextEpoch + projected Session history

entries.name: rehydrateReadCoverageEvidence
entries.schema: read coverage metadata + line ranges + token/file limits
entries.output: validated numbered source excerpts for previously read ranges
entries.permission: read-only filesystem evidence; stale identity is rejected
entries.cancellation: bounded inline operation
entries.persistence: read metadata lives in context machine state; source text is reread only when file identity still matches
entries.contextCost: strict token budget and max-file cap
entries.gap: No persisted cross-process content cache is introduced; source identity is always revalidated before evidence is rehydrated.
entries.designNotes: FileReadState cache restoration after compact; projected context/read-state reconstruction

entries.name: compactMessages
entries.schema: context projection compaction
entries.output: summary + recent projection
entries.cancellation: compaction is turn-scoped
entries.concurrency: single active compaction per session turn
entries.persistence: context checkpoint
entries.contextCost: reduces active model projection
entries.gap: future manual/advanced compaction controls
entries.designNotes: compact/session-memory and compaction flow; runtime component/session/compaction.ts

entries.name: TaskManager
entries.schema: durable TaskRecord lifecycle for shell and agent workers
entries.output: task state, child-session linkage, bounded output reference, result/error, and parent notification metadata
entries.permission: not a user-facing permission boundary; callers remain subject to ToolRegistry/PermissionGate
entries.cancellation: worker/process cancellation plus durable cancelled state and cleanup
entries.concurrency: per-task file locks + worker identity checks + workspace scope conflict detection
entries.persistence: JSON task records + task event logs + managed output files
entries.contextCost: status metadata only; output is read explicitly through task_output
entries.gap: Ownership is currently local/durable-on-disk rather than a distributed multi-node scheduler.
entries.designNotes: Task state + TaskOutput/disk-output + AgentTool resume/background lifecycle; BackgroundJob + task child-session orchestration + subagent permission derivation

entries.name: task.notification
entries.schema: task id + terminal state + compact summary + output path + child session id + completion time
entries.output: synthetic parent-context notification
entries.permission: produced by durable TaskManager completion path
entries.cancellation: consumption is idempotent; abandoned child work is handled by TaskManager cancellation/recovery
entries.persistence: SessionStore events with consumed markers
entries.contextCost: compact metadata only; no raw output reread
entries.gap: UI rendering of richer task timelines remains a future presentation concern.
entries.designNotes: Task notification / LocalAgentTask completion injection; TaskTool.injectBackgroundResult + background job completion

entries.name: ToolDefinition schema boundary
entries.schema: JSON Schema inputSchema/outputSchema; recursive object/array/enum/constraint validation
entries.output: validated args or ToolValidationError before/after execution
entries.permission: validation precedes permission and execution; validated args are the permission input
entries.cancellation: no execution occurs on invalid input
entries.persistence: validation failures remain ordinary tool.call error outcomes through Agent lifecycle
entries.contextCost: schema text is measured by existing bounded tool-schema selector
entries.gap: Validation intentionally implements the JSON Schema subset currently used by TermAgent rather than importing a native schema runtime dependency.
entries.designNotes: Tool.inputSchema/outputSchema and safeParse before execution; Tool.make codec boundary; invalid input/output never succeeds

entries.name: batch
entries.schema: not applicable
entries.output: not implemented
entries.cancellation: not applicable
entries.concurrency: not applicable; generic batch execution is not a builtin
entries.persistence: not applicable
entries.contextCost: not applicable

entries.output: not implemented

entries.name: webfetch/websearch
entries.schema: bounded web fetch/search request schemas

entries.persistence: not applicable
